loader: Mantid Load on each RAW run individually
reason_loadvesuvio_not_used: RB2000209 primary runs are single-period Workspace2D data. Mantid 6.16.1 LoadVesuvio assumes the separately loaded monitor object is a WorkspaceGroup and calls getItem(), which fails for these runs.
monitor_role_detection: determined from Mantid instrument geometry, not hard-coded
transmission_formula: T(E) = R_sample(E) / R_control(E), where R(E) = downstream_monitor(E) / upstream_monitor(E)
control_strategy: Interpolate the exposure-independent empty-control monitor ratio between early and late empty-tank blocks using acquisition time.
scientific_classification: experimental standard-monitor proxy transmission; NOT the GEM-derived full-range transmission product
reason_sigma_not_calculated: Sample neutron path lengths have not yet been grounded.
